hooks.name: Guard against committing secrets
hooks.description: Inspects file writes for hardcoded AWS keys, GitHub tokens, or Slack webhooks and steers them into Secrets Manager / env vars (enforces requirement 6.5).

action.prompt: Before writing this file, check the content for hardcoded secrets: AWS access keys (AKIA...), AWS secret keys, GitHub tokens (ghp_..., github_pat_...), Slack webhook URLs (hooks.slack.com/services/...), or private keys. LusiScan requirement 6.5 mandates that all secrets are read from AWS Secrets Manager at runtime and never committed. If you detect a hardcoded secret, do NOT write it: replace it with an environment variable or a Secrets Manager lookup, or use a placeholder, and tell the user what you changed.
